title: Work scheme redesign — confirm the brief
question: Parchment Atelier stays. workSteps stay factual. What should this redesign prioritize for a Marbella villa owner?

options.label: Trust the schedule
options.thesis: Leave convinced every stage is dated, visible, and owned — then request a proposal.
options.viewport: Stages read as a contractual timetable; the CTA is the natural close.
options.risk: Can feel bureaucratic if the craft stays dry.

options.label: Scan, then depth
options.thesis: See all ten stages at a glance, then open one for detail without losing place.
options.viewport: A full process map leads; one stage expands into the first deep read.
options.risk: Map chrome can crowd the first viewport.

options.label: Feel the journey
options.thesis: Feel the project arc from first call to housewarming — then ask for a proposal.
options.viewport: Opening stage lands like chapter one; the rest unfolds as a paced story.
options.risk: Storytelling can dilute the contractual clarity that sells this studio.
